verdict.rationale: Superset's evidence covers running agents in worktrees, workspaces, automations on a schedule, CLI/SDK/MCP orchestration, and manual PR creation from the diff viewer, but nothing describes detecting a failed CI workflow and automatically diagnosing/fixing it with a proposed PR. The only tangential hint is that the CLI can be invoked 'from CI' (superset-docs-8), which falls far short of automated failure diagnosis and fix-PR generation.
